district: # GSR Schools and new-GSR orientations of the districts, shown in the "GSR School" section of each district page (/districts/<slug>/#gsr) and listed on /committees/gsr-school/. One row per school or orientation (kind = school or orientation) plus one row per link to the district's own GSR material (kind = link). district = slug from districts.csv (d09, d01-03 …). Rows starting with # are ignored.

# When it meets, in this order: calendar_uid = the Area Google Calendar entry of a school that has its own repeating entry (the page then shows its day, time, Zoom, flyer, notes and Add to calendar, all from the calendar; find the id in the event page's .ics file, line UID). start / end = 24-hour times (18:30) of a school held on the same day as the district business meeting: the page shows the meeting's next dates at that time and the meeting's place. when_en / when_es = its day in plain words when it meets on a day of its own, worded as the calendar words it ("Every last Thursday" / "Cada último jueves"; start / end then give its time). where_en / where_es = plain words: in a row with calendar_uid or with start / end only they are a short note under the place (a side room, an entrance, or what the district's own website says when it differs); otherwise they are the place. format = In person | Hybrid | Virtual (leave empty when not known; a calendar entry has its own).

# title_* = the name shown; about_* = one line saying what it is; study_* = what is studied (optional); email = a ROLE address (…@msca09aa.org) for this school only — empty = the district's GSR School Chair (data/trusted-servants.csv, position GSR School Chair) when the roster names one, else the district's own address. Link rows: title_* = the link text, about_* = one line under it, url = the address (public pages and files only: check a PDF for personal details before linking it), icon = a Lucide icon name (default file-text). show = no hides a row. sort orders the rows of a district. notes = sources and reminders for editors, never shown. A repeating Service School entry in the calendar whose title says GSR or RSG and whose Host: is the district is shown even without a row here.
